title: mdbase.app-settings 1.0.0 record contract view
description: The reserved fields every app settings record shares. Everything else in the record belongs to the app and is described by the app's own settings contract.

app.description: The app whose clients honour these settings, such as tasknotes or dev.mdbase.reader.

scope.description: Who the values apply to: everyone using the app in this collection, or one person.

user.description: A link to the mdbase.person record the values apply to. Present only when scope is user.

settings_version.description: The version of the app's settings schema that last wrote the record. A client that does not understand it treats the settings as read-only.
